description:
Review all related changed paths in one call with paths; do not request a diff per file.
Default: changes since your last diff, paged. mode head/staged/unstaged/task selects the whole
comparison. Optional incremental/paged review; native git diff is also valid.

detail_ref.description: Reference from an earlier reply: continue that result.

mode.description: The whole diff: `head` (uncommitted), `staged`, `unstaged` or `task` (since activation). Omit for only what changed since your last diff.

paths.description: Worktree-relative files or directories to limit the diff to; literal paths only.

provenance.description: Return the exact worktree and comparison identity header instead of the compact default.

name: ide.diff

description:
Batch all related production and test changes into files, one atomic multi-file operation
and one project check. Each file accepts symbol/content, scoped old/new, line changes or
creation. Read affected units together first; do not submit one call per file or tiny hunk.
Reuse exact operation_id only for an identical retry. The write reply is immediate; the
project check (cargo check, pyright or tsc) completes separately.

add_import.description: With `path`: an import statement as written in the file; added after the other imports.

items.description: Up to 32 changes to the file `path`: each is `symbol` with `content` or `old`/`new`, `lines`, `add_import` or `remove_import`. All apply or none.

content.description: Replacement or inserted code, including the symbol's doc comment and attributes.

files.description: Up to 16 files in one call: {path, changes}, {path, create:true, content} or {path, content}. All apply or none; one project check runs.

lines.description: With `path`: file lines `a-b` to replace; for code prefer a `symbol` or a window.

new.description: The replacement for `old`; empty deletes the match.

new_name.description: For rename: the new identifier, applied project-wide.

old.description: Exact text to replace with `new`; it must occur once in the scope (the `symbol`, else the whole `path`).

op.description: replace (default), insert (placed by `where`), delete or rename (to `new_name`, project-wide) the `symbol`.

operation_id.description: Optional name that makes a retry safe: repeating it never applies the edit twice.

remove_import.description: With `path`: the import statement to remove, as written in the file.

symbol.description: Address `src/a.rs#Type/method`, a window `…/method:3-5` (lines of the symbol) or a region `src/a.rs#@imports`.

where.description: For insert: before/after the anchor symbol, or first/last member of a container anchor.

name: ide.edit

description:
Batch related roots with symbols (up to 8) for shared signatures, indirect faults or wider
impact. callers shows impact, callees dependencies, both both sides; depth 2 usually suffices
(1–3), tests:true expands tests. In Bridge mode even warm graphs accept a job; completion
arrives automatically. Continue independent work or end the turn; never poll or finish/stop
while awaiting results. Tiny edits need the ide.symbol direct-neighbor card.

depth.description: Levels to expand; 2 is usually enough.

detail_ref.description: Read the saved result named by a Bridge notice, only when more detail is needed. Use alone; never poll.

direction.description: callers: impact of changing it; callees: execution/dependency path; both: both sides.

symbol.description: Address `src/a.rs#Type/method`, or a bare name to search the project.

symbols.description: Up to 8 addresses or bare names in one call, request order; a failed one fails only itself.

tests.description: Show test symbols as nodes (marked `[test]`) instead of collapsing them into one `+N tests` line per parent.

name: ide.graph

description:
Read known detail_refs together in one batch when saved detail is needed; do not query
references one by one. File diagnostics use kind:diagnostics+path; project checks use
kind:problems. Unknown never means clean; no check starts. Test results/history/output
belong to ide.test; graph/read pages use their own tools. Never poll async state.

detail_ref.description: Reference from an earlier reply: continue that result.

detail_refs.description: Several references answered in order in one reply; not with `detail_ref`.

kind.description: problems: project checks; diagnostics: file provider reports.

language.description: With problems: limit to one language.

offset.description: With problems: continue from this problem index.

name: ide.inspect

description:
Batch skeletons with paths (up to 24) or one glob covering the related files. Do not outline
files one at a time when they fit a batch. Returns symbol/region addresses, signatures and
docs without bodies; collect the needed addresses and pass them together to ide.read items.

glob.description: Worktree-relative pattern (`*`, `?`, `**`), e.g. `crates/x/src/**/*.rs`; at most 24 files.

kinds.description: Comma list of symbol kinds to keep (a container of a match still shows); `region` also lists @header, @imports.

path.description: File or directory relative to the worktree; group related entries in paths.

paths.description: Up to 24 worktree-relative files, outlined in request order.

name: ide.outline

description: Batch source reads: items [{symbol:"src/a.rs#f"}, {path:"src/b.rs",offset:1,limit:80}]. Paths are relative to the active worktree; offset/limit are native-style line coordinates. Read related units together. Already-read unchanged items return an acknowledgement; force:true rereads after context loss. Do not reread your own successful edit merely to verify it.

detail_ref.description: Continue a saved read page; use alone.

force.description: Return source again even when already read and unchanged in this context.

items.description: Batch up to 32 source/text reads: {symbol} (address/window/path:line) or {path} with a host-style line range.

limit.description: Line count with path; default 2000 when offset is used.

offset.description: First line with path: 1-based; 0 also means 1.

name: ide.read

description:
Activate once per agent/worktree; reuse this activation for the whole batch workflow.
Returns project languages, commands, layout and call forms. Collect related targets before
outline/symbol/graph, read them together, then one multi-file edit and one test batch.
Do not start again per file. Call ide.stop once after all required results are collected.

activation_id.description: Stable id for this activation; repeating it returns the same activation. Optional.

environment.description: Environment per language, optionally per root (`python:packages/alpha`): a candidate the start card lists, a path to one, or `auto`.

read_only.description: Start as a reader; the default is the one writer allowed per worktree.

root.description: Absolute directory to activate, below an allowed root; defaults to the host's project directory.

name: ide.start

activation_id.description: Optional, accepted for symmetry with ide.start; stop always ends this session's activation.

name: ide.stop

description:
Batch related symbols with symbols (up to 8): signature/doc/definition/usages/history and
immediate neighbors (callers/callees). Every positive value means direct neighbors, never
depth. Use ide.graph for wider call chains. A precise UTF-8 use-site uses path+byte_offset.
Collect needed bodies and read them in one ide.read items batch.

byte_offset.description: Zero-based UTF-8 position; split/out-of-file offsets refuse. Pages use ide.inspect.

callees.description: 0–3: 0 omits; positive values return immediate callees. Deeper chains: ide.graph.

callers.description: 0–3: 0 omits; positive values return immediate callers. Deeper chains: ide.graph.

history.description: Include the last commits touching the definition (opt-in).

path.description: With byte_offset: semantic use-site; not symbol/symbols.

symbol.description: Address `src/a.rs#Type/method`, or a bare name to search the project.

symbols.description: Up to 8 addresses or bare names in one call, request order; a failed one fails only itself.

usages.description: Include usages (src/tests split, with source lines).

name: ide.symbol

description:
Batch tests/checks with targets: {symbol}, {path}, {pattern} or {command:[argv]}, up to 8.
One run id and budget; ordered steps run at the worktree root. In Bridge mode execution
accepts a run and completion arrives automatically. End an idle turn without finish/stop;
never poll. Read result:N, history:true or detail_ref; cancel:N requests owner cancellation
and completion follows process-group cleanup. Legacy deployments may return fast results inline.

budget_s.description: Seconds before the run is stopped and reported as timed out.

cancel.description: Cancel this actor’s active run; after cleanup the result is retained and Bridge-delivered when configured. No polling.

command.description: Explicit argv to run instead of the detected runner; all argument bytes together are limited to 16 KiB.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the worktree root; must resolve inside the worktree. Only with `command`.

detail_ref.description: Continue the saved output of a test result; no test is started.

env.description: Variables added to the inherited environment; only with `command`.

history.description: List this actor’s retained runs in the active worktree, newest first. Does not start or wait for work.

path.description: Run the tests in this file or directory.

pattern.description: Run tests whose name matches this substring (runner filter).

result.description: Read a retained run result once; never starts or waits for a run. Bridge delivers it automatically when configured; do not poll.

symbol.description: Run the tests that reference this address (`src/a.rs#Type/method`).

targets.description: Batch ≤8 {symbol}, {path}, {pattern} or {command:[argv]} checks. One budget and Bridge result; root cwd, ordered steps, per-target outcomes.

name: ide.test
